##
Bug Fixes

### Campaign

- Fixed a longstanding issue where ragdolls would be frozen for a couple of frames before flying away, falsely looking like lag.
- Fixed a bug where entering the upper part of Lagon's arena with specific movement skills could cause you to snap back out of the arena.
- Fixed a chest spawning in an unreachable location behind a tent in Liath's Road.
- Fixed a visual issue with Grael in The Burning Forest.
- Fixed an issue where Pannion's Student would still be there upon entering Pannion's Study during the fight in online play.
- Fixed multiple issues with camera view being obscured in various scenes.

#### Chapter 2

- The Precipice:
- Fixed issues with objects blocking camera view.
- Fixed some lighting issues on breakables.

#### Chapter 3

- The Lotus Halls:
- Fixed some missing and stretched textures.

#### Chapter 4

- The Risen Lake:
- Fixed a lighting issue with fire in the scene.
- Added quest icon to The Risen Lake's bridge interaction stone.

#### Chapter 6

- Festering Sewers
- Fixed some of the metal grate floor texturing not displaying properly.

#### Chapter 7

- The Gates of Solarum:
- Fixed an issue where footsteps would sound like they were on metal throughout the scene.

#### Chapter 8

- Liath's Tower
- Fixed an issue where transitions up the stairs triggered when approaching and didn't require a click. This caused loot that dropped near them to be unreachable.

- Seafloor Colosseum:
- Fixed an issue where player feet would visually sink into the moon portal platform.

### Enemies

#### General

- Fixed a bug where the Agile Harbinger's fire laser would sometimes not play its indicator correctly. It should be much clearer now.
- Fixed issue with missing animation on Imperial Sentries.
- Fixed a pathing issue with Incubated Wolves when first spawned.
- Fixed an issue where some of Praetor Taranis' attacks were too loud.
- Reduced the volume of enemy raptors.
- Fixed an issue where some foley sounds effects were missing on Stone Titan. Sounds now play as expected.

#### Bosses

- Fixed a bug where Admiral Harton's barks could reach party members in other scenes.
- Fixed an issue where the damage from the Emperor of Corpses’ explosion was sometimes larger than its indicator in online mode.
- Fixed an issue where Formosus could get stuck in its idle animation after teleporting.
- Fixed an issue where Majasa's Fire crystal was using lightning effects instead of fire.
- Fixed an issue where Spreading Frost was using player skill SFX for some of its abilities.
- Surtok’s flame cone visuals have been fixed.
- Fixed an issue where The Crimson Blade decoy's would die very quickly.

#### Champions

- Fixed the Frozen Wolf Champion, Ghost, being more common than intended compared to other champions.
- Fixed an issue with Swollen Corpse Champion where it did not have a proper name like other champions.

#### Random Encounter Enemies

- Fixed an issue with Bloodsteel Nemesis's attack SFX not being present.
- Fixed an issue where roaming omens could be permanently immune under certain conditions.

### Dungeons

- Fixed an issue where Julra would spam her teleport if a player stayed outside the arena.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes players in a party could respawn in the wrong place when they spend a key to respawn on a dungeon boss fight.
- Fixed Titan's heart spawning in the wrong place online.
- Fixed a bug where entering the arena would still display the enter arena UI.
- Fixed an issue where audio cues for Arena Champions were not playing.

### Items

- Fixed an issue where you couldn't corrupt a unique item if it came from ascending an item with a sealed affix.
- Fixed Corruption outcomes that set rolls to their highest or lowest values picking the wrong end of the range for some mods. Positive outcomes now always give the best possible rolls and negative outcomes the worst possible rolls, including on mods where lower values are better.
- Fixed several stats that were not correctly treated as "lower is better", which also caused reversed comparison arrows in item tooltips: Health and Ward lost when you use Evade (Nihilis), Hit Damage taken from Bosses and Rare Enemies (Effusive Oath), Current Health lost on potion use (Eternal Font), Damage Taken per Active Shadow (Gambit of an Erased Rogue), and Chance to Receive a Critical Strike (Fiery Dragon Shoes, Perilous Reflection).
- Fixed some affix values displaying one step above or below their intended range.
- Fixed a bug where the enchanted idol affix "Mana Increased and Mana regen with a minion" would not apply its increased mana regeneration effect.
- Fixed pyramid altar calculating what idol was above using the bottom left corner instead of the top left as the tooltip says.

#### Unique Items

##### Crystalwind

- Fixed a bug where Crystalwind stacks could be consumed by indirectly used bow attacks.

##### Elecoe's Abandon

- Elecoe's Abandon tooltip now explicitly states that only Direct casts of Acid Flask trigger its unique effect.

##### Chorus of Anurok

- Frogs now spawn with an animation instead of popping in.

##### Idols

- Fixed a bug where the "corrupted idol limit and increased effect of Weaver enchantment affixes for idols in refracted slots" altar affix was not applying increased effect to the relevant affixes.
- Fixed a bug where the Isolated Ornate Idol prefix's "less frequency of expending Storm Stacks" was not multiplicative with other sources of the same effect.
- Fixed a bug where the "Increased cooldown recovery speed of Reap and chance to cast Harvest at 3 nearby enemies when you use Reap" enchanted idol affix was not casting Harvest.

##### Apiarists Set

- Fixed a bug where equipping a full apiarist set could cause the Grace period on entering an echo/cave/tomb to fail to be removed on movement or ability cast.

##### Sinathia’s Set

- Fixed Sinathia's Dying Breath Reforged not granting its flat curse damage.

##### Weaver’s Set

- Fixed a bug where the Weaver set bonus increased the effect of legendary affixes on weapons and shields that were not Weaver's Will items.

### Monolith

- Fixed a bug where players in a party would see current echo stability progress even if they were not in the echo.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the "Complete Echo" button would not work.
- Fixed an issue where certain Woven Echoes were missing Environmental SFX.
- Fixed an issue where cleansing Corruption more than once at a single Sanctuary of Eterra would only apply the first cleanse to enemy health and damage and to increased item rarity.
- Fixed an issue where killing your first Harbinger could sometimes not bring you to Shattered Road.
- Fixed an issue where the green button for Open portal on the Monolith completion disappeared if you respawned on a boss fight.
- Renamed Time Beast Echo Chain to Rift Beast Echo Chain.
- Fixed an issue where, when running a Rift Beast Echo Chain, the green portal could appear before the echo is complete.
- Fixed the Monolith Hub's Timeline transition sound.
- Ground decals will now correctly appear in the scene Imperial Metropolis.
- Fixed a bug where the quest tracker could fail to display quests after leaving an echo in offline mode.

##### Harvested Titan

- Fixed a visual issue with environmental soul cages.

#### Omen's Veil

- Fixed some movement issues for the player when clicking around their model.

#### Pinnacle of Chaos

- Fixed some movement issues for the player when clicking around their model.

#### The Crystal Cove

- Fixed an issue where players could not walk back through the same-scene transition in the second area of the zone.

#### The Lair of Formosus

- Fixed an issue where some objects could obstruct the camera view.

### Random Encounters

- Disabled the Nemesis proximity chat bark in the Conquered Tower Woven Echo.
- Fixed an issue where killing the omen too fast could lead to their minions not being properly absorbed.
- Fixed Exiled Mages not dropping experimental items when killed outside the Monolith of Fate.
- Fixed players getting stuck in online in the Caves and the Cemetery.
- Omen loot sphere visual fixes.
- Fixed Skarven Bloodhorn's vendor window staying open after leaving a Primal Hunt cave.

#### Tombs of the Erased

- Silken Cocoons can no longer be moved by player abilities.

#### Omen Windows

- Fixed an issue where the area of a window could display incorrectly on the map.

#### Arena

- Fixed an issue where you couldn't respawn in the arena lobby after abandoning the activity if two or more players were still inside.
- Fixed an issue where leaving the arena in a party when dead would count as an extra death for the deaths counter.

### Item Factions

- Fixed gold bags being affected by the Zerrick gold multiplier.
- Fixed the Clear Filter button by refreshing the bazaar item list after clearing filters, adding the missing click sound, and correcting its selected sprite reference so it no longer remains visually stuck in the hover state.
- Zerrick will no longer follow players to Traveler’s Rest.

#### Bazaar

- Fixed an issue where implicit text items could stretch to the full parent width, causing their text to overflow over the item's image.
- Fixed an issue that caused a Bazaar Back button to sometimes not be clickable.
- Fixed navigating to affix and subtype picker roll text inputs on controller (previously could only select the slider).
- Fixed some modifiers being unable to be typed in the Bazaar when filtering, such as:
- Oracle Amulet's Less Damage Over Time Taken.
- Nihilis' Seconds of Frenzy after you use Evade.
- Acolyte Idol's Less Damage Over Time Taken.

### Character

#### General

- Fixed a bug where different Primalist forms as well as Acolyte's reaper form would turn dark when going through monoliths.
- Fixed a bug where excess minions could remain summoned after unequipping an item that increased their maximum number
- Fixed an issue where you could get stuck on the evade animation if you cast certain abilities during it.
- Fixed a bug where Sapping Strikes and Mana Warp could restore mana or health from indirectly used abilities in some cases.
- Fixed an issue where you could keep an ability from a different mastery on the skill bar after respecializing the mastery.
- Fixed a bug where "leech also drains the health of the nearest enemy within 6 meters" was draining less health than intended in almost all cases, and could also unintentionally multiply the damage dealt by Lich's Scornful Blood ("instead of healing you, your leech drains the health of nearby enemies"). The result is leech drain effects will deal more damage than before, especially at lower amounts, unless you had Scornful Blood and other leech drain sources simultaneously, in which case it will deal less damage.

#### Beastmaster Passive Tree

- Fixed a bug where Aspect of the Lynx, when applied to companions, was modified by increases to Aspect of the Shark instead of Aspect of the Lynx.
- Fixed a bug where Aspect of the Viper applied to companions was being affected by modifiers to Shark effect instead of Viper effect, and its effect was unintentionally reduced by allocating Feeding Frenzy
- Fixed a bug where the threshold bonus of Serrated Claws was unintentionally scaling with allocated points

#### Druid Passive Tree

- Fixed a bug where Fetid Resilience was unintentionally also granting less damage over time taken while transformed

#### Shaman Passive Tree

- Fixed a bug where Ironbark's threshold bonus could grant much more health regeneration for totems than intended under certain conditions
- Fixed a bug where Swirling Maelstrom's chance to cast Maelstrom when hit would always succeed despite being a 5% chance per point (it still always respected its cooldown)

#### Void Knight Passive Tree

- Fixed a display bug where Finality, Patient Doom, and Time Legion displayed a threshold bonus indicator despite having no threshold bonus.

#### Warlock Passive Tree

- Fixed a bug where Wither's threshold bonus was granting less damage over time taken from withered enemies instead of its stated less damage taken from withered enemies

### Acolyte Skills

#### Aura of Decay

- Fixed an issue where the Frozen Touch node had no sound.
- Fixed an issue where the cold conversion version's sound did not loop properly.
- Fixed an issue where Freezing Blast didn't have sound.
- Frozen Touch, Incipient Decay, Corruption, and Poison Bolt now display tooltips for their mentioned subskills.

#### Assemble Abomination

- Fixed a bug that could cause your Abomination to cast Sacrifice on itself.

#### Bone Curse

- Fixed a bug where incorrect visuals could play under certain conditions.
- Fixed a bug where indirectly casting Bone Curse while Signet of Agony was allocated would consume mana without casting anything. Indirect casts in this case will now cast a non-aura Bone Curse.

#### Chaos Bolts

- Fixed a visual issue where Chaos Bolt's area did not properly scale when its area was increased by skill tree nodes.

#### Corrupted Form

- Fixed an issue where Corrupted Form's "is low life" stat was not being synchronized, causing character sheet values to incorrectly depend on actual health thresholds online.

#### Drain Life

- Fixed a bug where Soul Blast hit enemies in a smaller area than intended.
- Fixed an issue where the Soul Blast node had no sound.

#### Dread Shade

- Fixed an issue where the Doom Brand node was too loud.
- Fixed a bug causing the Frenzied Phantom node to grant Frenzy for as long as Dread Shade was active, instead of only for the stated duration after it was cast.

#### Flay

- Fixed a bug where the Blood Eruption spell subskill had a base damage of 2 instead of its intended 40.
- Fixed a bug where, while the setting to move to attack enemies out of range option was disabled, casting Flay while hovering an enemy out of range would still result in Flay moving to attack that enemy, instead of doing nothing as expected.
- Fixed a bug where camera smoothing would not apply to Flay's movement while playing online.

#### Ghost Flame

- Fixed an issue where the Decrepit Mortals node had no sound.

#### Hungering Souls

- Fixed a bug where Dominion of Undeath was reducing cone width instead of increasing it.

#### Profane Veil

- Fixed a bug where Singleminded was granting more cooldown recovery speed instead of its intended increased cooldown recovery speed. Its description has also been clarified to reflect this.
- Fixed an issue where the Necrotic version of Profane Orb was barely audible.

#### Rip Blood

- Fixed an issue where Rip Blood could miss enemies positioned at a different elevation from the player.
- Fixed a bug where after allocating Marrow Drinker, the hit VFX and SFX would not play when hitting minions, and would incorrectly still play when targeting enemies.

#### Soul Feast

- Fixed a bug where Incision’s more physical ailment damage per 100 missing health was not scaling with points allocated.

#### Summon Skeletal Mage

- Fixed an issue where the Undead Mortars ability was barely audible.

#### Transplant

- Fixed an issue where Transplant's Blood Pool detonation from the Reign of Blood node could appear offset upwards.

### Sentinel Skills

#### Abyssal Echoes

- Fixed a bug causing the Vorpal Reverberations node to have no effect.
- Fixed a bug which caused Abyssal Echoes to be cast in place when either Dark Torrent or Screaming Rifts nodes were selected. It will now target enemies in front of you and then fall back to a random nearby enemy.

#### Anomaly

- Anomaly's timelock now correctly stuns enemies after returning.
- Fixed a bug in online where holding the key for Anomaly's combo skill would sometimes cause Anomaly to be uncastable until re-equipping it.

#### Healing Hands

- Fixed a bug where channeled Healing Hands's mana cost could be reduced to 0. It now has a minimum mana cost of 1 when channeled, similar to other channeled skills.
- Fixed an issue where Cloud Voyager did not reduce Healing Hands cooldown when Healing Hands was used directly on an ally.

#### Holy Aura

- Fixed a bug where Holy Aura's stat buffs would last several seconds longer than the activation duration when the Concentration node is allocated.

#### Lunge

- Fixed a bug with Sentinel's Lunge causing it to slide after the animation is done.
- Fixed an issue where the Art of the Spear's visuals did not match its effective area.

#### Manifest Armor

- Fixed an issue with Manifest Armor where nodes like Titan Sword would apply stats based the player's equipment at the moment of summoning and wouldn't be affected by any equipment changes that happen after.

#### Multistrike

- Description has been updated to specify it only grants a stack of Armament when you directly use Multistrike

#### Rive

- Fixed a bug where the second and third abilities in the combo did not display an area tag. This was only a display issue.
- Fixed an issue where Rive's DPS tooltip could use combined combo values instead of the damage of the current strike.

#### Smite

- Fixed an issue where Smite played default SFX when Order of Lagon node was activated.
- Fixed a bug where Smite's Forceful Impact node would sometimes not knock enemies back.

#### Vengeance

- Fixed a bug where an enemy could not be hit by more than one retaliation stemming from the same cast of Vengeance.

#### Void Cleave

- Fixed a bug where Void Cleave's cooldown was still reduced by the Valiant Charge passive node while its Movement tag was removed by Abberoth's Command.

### Mage Skills

#### Arcane Ascendance

- Fixed a bug where Arcane Acuity lasted for 5 spells instead of its stated 4.

#### Black Hole

- Fixed an issue where the damage from the Collapse node wasn’t converted to Fire type when Red Giant or Binary Star was specialized.
- Fixed a visual bug where Black Hole would jitter when close to its target with Drifting Singularity, especially if Binary System was also allocated.

#### Flaming Rush

- Fixed an issue where Blazing Flux's doubled bonuses could fail to apply at 150% Fire Resistance.

#### Enchant Weapon

- Fixed a bug where the passive effects of Conduit, Burst of Fire, and Icicle Strike could apply while Enchant Weapon is not on your bar

#### Elemental Nova

- Fixed a bug where Conflagrating Speed was not granting its stated increased cooldown recovery speed.

#### Fire Aura

- Fixed an issue where the hitbox didn't fully line up with the ability visuals.

#### Fire Ball

- Fixed a bug where Mana Sphere did not affect Fireball's mana cost if it was channeled.

#### Firebrand

- Fixed a bug where Firebrand's stop range was not affected by the range increases granted by Firebrand stacks. This means that if the move into attack range setting is enabled, you will not move closer than necessary to hit enemies with Firebrand.
- Fixed a bug where Snow Blink was not adding the movement tag to Glacier.
- Fixed an issue where the Pyre node’s Flame Wave had no sound.

#### Frost Claw

- Fixed a bug where the projectile speed effects of the Spark of Celerity and Frozen Reign nodes would have no effect.

#### Ice Barrage

- Fixed an issue where the Frigid Doom node did not have sound.

#### Lightning Blast

- Fixed a bug where Convergence could still chain even while out of mana with Innate Conduit.

#### Meteor

- Fixed an issue where the Shattering Star node had no sound.
- Fixed an issue where Heat Flux failed to trigger Frost Claw if Frost Claw’s mana cost was reduced to 0 while the player had negative or zero mana.

#### Snap Freeze

- Fixed an issue where Shiver Armor did not activate while Snap Freeze had a charge on cooldown but still had remaining charges available.
- Snap Freeze with the Snap Shock node enabled displays only the Lightning tag, without the Cold tag, and generates only Lightning runes.

#### Surge

- The more Lightning damage granted by the Conduit node now respects the conversions of Surge.

#### Static

- Fixed an issue where Static max charge VFX and sound were repeatedly triggered with Storm Chaser node active and passive Static charge gain.
- Fixed a bug where some sources of Static charge generation could grant charges while Static was not equipped on your bar.

#### Runic Invocation

- Fixed an issue where the Hydrahedron cube from Runic Invocation disappeared before it finished firing projectiles in online play.

#### Runebolt

- Fixed a bug where Amplified Cascade's Tri-Elemental bolts combined with Devastator's explosions created a Tri-Elemental Bolt that errantly gained an additional source of 50% more hit damage only for its explosion. This unintentional damage modifier on the explosion could only apply to targets that weren't hit by the projectile, making it very unlikely to have had any impact in single target scenarios.

### Rogue Skills

#### Acid Flask

- Fixed an issue where Cluster Bombs from Acid Flask were not converted to cold damage and did not use cold visuals when the Vial of Volatile Ice node was active.
- Fixed an issue where poison resistance shred from the Contamination node was not converted to fire resistance shred when the Explosive Flask node was active.
- Fixed an issue where Acid Flask's Cluster Bombs would not trigger when the Alchemist's Gift node is allocated.
- Fixed a bug where flasks thrown with Toxic Salvo allocated would have a slightly longer than intended delay between the first and second flask

#### Bladestorm

- Fixed an issue where throwing Umbral Blades with Slagstorm node active into Bladestorm reduced Bladestorm’s area instead of increasing it.

#### Dive Bomb

- Fixed an issue where Dive Bomb was not cast at shadow locations when the Birds Aren't Real node was active.
- Fixed a bug where Featherfall was not applying to indirect casts of Dive Bomb. Shadow Falcons still won't use Featherfall.

#### Explosive Trap

- Fixed an issue where Explosive Trap's cooldown could be incorrect when using Freezing Trap and No Man's Land together.

#### Shadow Rend

- Fixed a bug where Loose Pockets could create no Umbral Blades if the most recent use of Umbral Blades was a recall. Loose Pockets triggering Umbral Blades will now always perform the first throw.
- Fixed an issue where Shadow Rend retained the Short Range and Movement tag after allocating Night's Approach.

#### Puncture

- Fixed an issue where Puncture triggered by Spear Trap inherited the charge from the player’s last direct Puncture cast.

#### Shift

- Fixed an issue where Shift's Return To Shadow Location could undo a Shadow Cascade swap.

#### Flurry

- Fixed a bug that caused the range increase of shockwave in the Flurry tree to only increase the travel distance of the shockwave itself instead of extending the overall reach of the ability. This makes the node roughly 6x as effective.

#### Lethal Mirage

- Fixed a bug where Shocking Grasp was not converting Lethal Mirage's base damage to lightning.
- Fixed a bug where shadows created by Doom and Gloom could be partially underground.

#### Net

- Fixed an issue where Engineering Smarts did not reduce Net’s cooldown.
- Fixed a display bug where Leading the Hunt did not state that it required a direct use to grant the Huntress Advantage buff.

#### Shadow Cascade

- Fixed an issue where daggers thrown by Shadow Cascade's Dagger Dance node would not automatically target nearby enemies when only one point was allocated to Dagger Dance.

#### Smoke Bomb

- Fixed a bug where Hasty Combustion could cause smoke clouds to ignite immediately if you were standing in the location of a previous smoke cloud.

#### Umbral Blades

- Fixed a bug where Umbral Blades could inflict ailments a second time to nearby enemies upon landing in the ground.

### Primalist Skills

#### Avalanche

- Fixed a bug where Upheavals cast by Excavation would only move a very short distance before disappearing.

#### Earthquake

- Fixed a bug where Aftershocks were not affected by sources of increased area for area skills outside of Earthquake's skill tree

#### Entangling Roots

- Fixed a bug where the benefits of Venomsting were not being tripled for scorpions
- Fixed a bug where Wild Weapons was not granting added physical damage to allies' bow or throwing attacks

#### Gathering Storm

- Fixed a bug where Storm Bolts cast via Lagonian Diplomacy did not apply the cap on more damage and mana consumed from Excited Bolts
- Fixed a bug where Storm Bolts cast via Lagonian Diplomacy would not receive the shock chance from Jolting Strikes in some cases

#### Maelstrom

- Fixed a bug that caused the Typhoon node in Maelstrom to reduce the duration of Maelstrom by 10% per point.

#### Spriggan Form

- Fixed an issue where Roar of the Woodland in Spriggan Form did not increase the duration of existing Thorn Shields when casting Barkskin.

#### Summon Bear

- Fixed a bug where Thorn Eruption's chance to occur could become higher than intended after hitting a boss or rare enemy

#### Summon Sabertooth

- Fixed an issue where the idle animation would get stuck when moving around.
- Fixed a bug where Gouging Claws was granting +67% bleed chance per point instead of its stated 34%

#### Summon Scorpion

- Fixed an issue where Rest for the Wicked granted increased critical strike chance instead of added critical strike chance.
- Fixed an issue where Baby Scorpions could use incorrect pathing behavior immediately after being summoned.

#### Summon Storm Totem

- Fixed a bug where Storm's Reach was granting increased radius instead of its intended increased area.
- Fixed a bug where modifiers to the area of Storm Totem's Blizzard did not affect its visual size.
- Fixed a bug where increases to area for minion area skills outside of Storm Totem's tree were not applying to its abilities.

#### Summon Thorn Totem

- Fixed the Majasa's Fang Thorn Totem cosmetic displaying a red enemy outline instead of the green allied outline when the totem was converted to cold damage.

#### Swarmblade Form

- Fixed a bug where Plague of Locusts was not granting more Locust Swarm damage per locust consumed while Soaring Scourge was allocated.
- Fixed a bug where summoned Locusts did not have cold converted visuals when Swarmblade Form was converted to cold.

#### Swipe

- Fixed a bug where Wrath of the Wild was granting more cold damage per shock on the target instead of its stated more cold damage per chill on the target
- Fixed a bug where Storm Scour's lightning penetration based on your attunement was not being applied to your Bear when it uses Swipe

#### Tempest Strike

- Fixed a bug where Thunder Tempests from Druid's Call could not trigger the effect of Cloudburst Conduit.
- Fixed a bug where Bulwark of Nature's effect was not applying when the Tempests were cast by the player instead of a totem

#### Upheaval

- Fixed a bug where Tremblor could grant Earth Shattering stacks even if Upheaval was used indirectly

#### Werebear Form

- Fixed a bug where the Entangling Roots created by the Woodland Bear node would not display the on-ground growing roots visuals.

### UI

- Fixed a bug where characters below level 15 had a 0% critical success chance when crafting.
- When a craft consumes 0 forging potential from an effect such as a critical success, a green "0" is shown for the forging potential cost, rather than a red "-0".
- Center UI panels no longer block movement for WASD or Point and Click.
- Fixed Choose Blessing Panel preventing player movement when open.
- Fixed various bugs causing the chat to be difficult to interact with on controller.
- A visual bug with the minimap on lower resolution screens has been fixed.
- Fixed a bug where non-stacking ailment tooltip DPS would be estimated incorrectly if the skill had particularly high application chance for that ailment.
- Fixed a bug where quest modals would sometimes appear empty or not at all.
- Fixed a bug where some unique item modifiers did not display their alt text.
- Fixed an issue where ground item labels could render on top of the party UI, making it impossible to click a party member's portrait (for example, to teleport to them) when a label overlapped it.
- Fixed an issue where invalid bottom bar prompts were displayed for Affix Shards placed in the Forge crafting slot.
- Fixed an issue where invalid bottom bar prompts were displayed for Glyphs and Runes placed in the Forge crafting slot. Fixed stale bottom prompt behavior so invalid item actions like Unequip Item are no longer shown after moving from equipped items back to crafting items such as Affix Shards, Glyphs, or Runes.
- Fixed an issue on gamepad when there was no pop-up to tell you that you don't have enough gold to purchase a new stash tab.
- Fixed an Issue with Ward UI being too bright.
- Fixed lag spikes when opening the crafting materials panel.
- Fixed panel focusing issues after inventory closes and other navigation issues with the inventory.
- Fixed some shop dialogues.
- Fixed the Season 4 entry in the stash cycle selector appearing blank.
- Fixed Woven Echoes not being linkable in chat.
- Fixed an issue where players could open the main menu or the controller options menu while using the virtual keyboard, leading to broken or inconsistent gamepad input. The main menu and the controller options menu close the virtual keyboard before opening.
- Item container sorting is now stable (Items will no longer shuffle around if you sort a sorted container).
- Player health bar no longer appears aliased in some areas.
- Solved some visual issues with the crafting tutorial with controller.
- Updated the stash flow so center-panel stash buttons open only the stash first, preventing overlap and the immediate closure caused by the panel offset logic.
- Updated crafting stash filtering so corrupted items are no longer highlighted as valid crafting candidates.
- Fixed a bug where pressing tab while viewing an item tooltip would cause every prompt to show.
- Fixed a display bug where the Rogue's body armor affix for additional mirages with Lethal Mirage did not display a value.
- Fixed an issue with Timeline search by name that could get into a state where it greys out all islands while the search bar is clear.

#### Ability Icons

- Properly updates icons for abilities with minion requirements and combo parts on the bar.

#### Inventory Menu

- Fixed an issue where tooltips for ground items are displayed behind Inventory when using a controller.
- Added an Inventory-open guard so pressing R2 / RT from the Character Sheet only switches focus to Inventory when it exists, preventing navigation from being lost.
- Fixed an issue where the weapon swap inventory space check can incorrectly fail when attempting to quick equip a weapon while you already have a weapon equipped.

#### Weaver Tree

- Fixed an issue where the ‘Inescapable Omens’ node in the Weaver Tree could not be focused using a controller's directional pad if previous nodes were activated.

#### Shrines

- Fixed an issue where the Gathering Storm Shrine cold conversion spikes would spawn in the air, not synced with the ground.
- Fixed visual effects for Armored Phoenix, Osprix Firemage, and the Phoenix shrine

#### Other

- Improved visual clarity by adjusting and where vfx exit points are placed and minor arrow bugs.
- Fixed a memory leak associated with scene transitions.
- Fixed an issue where MTX Fractured Flay's SFX would not playback.
- Fixed an issue where SFX could dynamically effect Music in an exaggerated way if the SFX slider was turned down in Settings.
- Fixed issue on capes that appear them to show as scrunched/crumpled.
- Fixed issue where connecting overlay could persist after leaving the game and reconnecting to the same server.f
- Rogue / Primalist no longer enter combat state in towns.
- Fixed desync caused by items with 0 quantity existing on server.
- Fixed visual item duplication due to a missing reference.
- Fixed the camera not zooming out to the class line when creating your first character.
- Fixed an issue where MTX abilities that had a sub-skill that spawned minions would not apply the MTX to the minion until you changed scenes.

##
Looking Ahead to Season 5

That wraps up our look at the Season 5 Patch Notes. We are preparing behind the scenes to bring you everything you need for a strong start when Season 5 drops on October 1st. Check back soon for any news and updates as we get closer to the launch of Rage of the Frostborn!

If you haven't already, head over to our Discord to stay up to date with our content development.
